## Review result: incomplete—event evidence unavailable

I verified the relevant work order and the September Pending Close cutoff, but the assigned supporting event records returned **“supporting records not staged.”** I therefore cannot reliably determine whether a late-created event occurred.

| Item | Verified finding |
|---|---|
| Manufacturing order | **MO-25-09-1070** |
| Work order ID | **WO-2025-09-004** |
| Operation / product | Racine–DeKoven / Cooler Plate Pack |
| Cost period | **Sep-25 — PER-COST-2025-09** |
| Recorded period status | **PENDING_CLOSE** |
| Exact Pending Close time | **2025-09-30T18:00:00** |
| Source transaction, amount, event-created time, lateness and accounting status | **Not verifiable from the available assigned records** |

The cutoff is reproduced exactly as recorded; no timezone or UTC offset was supplied.

### Oracle policy and conclusion

Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM Cost Management 26B, **“Cost Accounting Period Statuses and Transaction Accounting”** (PDF page 233; printed page 225), states that newly created transactions falling in or before a Pending Close period **will not be staged or processed until the period is closed or reopened**. Revenue lines, COGS recognition and manual cost adjustments are exceptions that continue processing.

Thus, processing a **non-exempt** transaction created after the cutoff would be inconsistent with that treatment. However, **I cannot conclude whether this work order’s recorded accounting status is consistent without its event record**, including its type, creation time and status. The missing records do not establish that no late event exists.

No database records were changed. The partial audit and provenance were saved to `/cache/work/worker_ea849f789d1e/audit-report.json`; the submitted review remains **needs evidence**. An authorized event extract for **WO-2025-09-004** is needed to complete the finding.
